entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Source Generators: show generated files in solution explorer without loosing intallisense #80849
  • 'Go to definition' navigates to completely wrong type #80848

Closed

  • SeparatedSyntaxList.ReplaceSeparator throws ArgumentException with bad message #2496
    Backlog
  • Need docs about GlobalStatementSyntax #17118
    Backlog
  • Outdated Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Features package #80814
    18.3
  • Need way to check if a particular (modern) extension member is applicable to a receiver type. #80273
  • Fix the SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80683
    18.3
  • Lifetime of collection expressions seems to be longer than it should be in some cases #80107
    18.3
  • Generated source code does not refresh #76283
  • Many Feature * is currently unavailable due to an internal error. Exit code 0 #79184
  • Missing nullability warning in `Nullability_CollectionExpression_Add_02` #80850
    18.3
  • Stack overflow in compiler binding out-vars in implicit object creation. #80518
    18.3
  • Compiler let's you create collection types with required properties with a collection expression. #80833
    18.3
  • New model classes not recognized without restarting Visual Studio in large projects #79662
  • Incorrect output of ToMinimalDisplayString() with namespace hiding #36654
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.polytype-11121.182 #80851
  • Allow to ignore specific folders for IDE0130 #80847

PullRequests

Created

  • Mention conditionals in CFG section in Compiler Test Plan #80855
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove RestoreUseStaticGraphEvaluation workaround #80852
    Area-Compilers
  • Don't add parenthesis when committing type with accessible nested type using dot #80846
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Try to reuse initialized generator drivers when we can #80845
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Fix ArgumentException in SeparatedSyntaxList.ReplaceSeparator to use proper message and paramName #80690
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add XML documentation for GlobalStatementSyntax #80697
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Next
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers, Code Gen Quality, Next
  • Completion for `#:project` paths (round 2) #80844
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Extensions: Add ReduceExtensionMember API #80659
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode, Next
  • Fix typos and improve clarity in documentation #80854
    Community, Next
  • Fix SafeContext of Span-valued collection expressions to match specification #80684
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Collection Expressions, Next
  • Improve detection of invalid references for implicitly typed expression variables declared within implicit object creation expressions. #80546
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Target-Typed New, Next
  • Add test demonstrating behavior of ToMinimalDisplayString. #80757
    Area-Compilers, Test, Next
  • Only set DOTNET_HOST_PATH if something was installed #80842
    Area-Infrastructure, Next

Updated

  • Use standard lookup and overload resolution for `true`/`false` operators while binding applications of user-defined `&&`/`||` operators #80836
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove warning from 'in enum' extension methods #80708
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Mark CS4009 error as a "build only" error. #80698
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Add MSBuild warning when DOTNET_HOST_PATH is not found #80739
  • Fix handling of SymbolDisplayCompilerInternalOptions.UseArityForGenericTypes option for non-native symbol implementations #80826
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error message for record inheritance without parameter list #80795
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix SyntaxFactory.Identifier to throw ArgumentNullException instead of NullReferenceException #80699
    Area-Compilers
  • Make string concat assert more precise #80619
    Area-Compilers
  • Optimize CopyRefAssembly task by checking file size and timestamp before MVID extraction #80635
    Area-Compilers
  • More tests for 'with(...)' element scenarios. #80831
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Ensure that locals at the top level of a constructor have the same safe-context as parameters #80807
    Area-Compilers
  • Use core compiler on netfx hosts with toolset package #80631
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix ref safe context of assignments to be their RHS #80633
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: address some diagnostic quality issues #80827
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Add runtime NullReferenceException validation to foreach null iteration tests #80839
    Area-Compilers, Test
  • Fix go to definition for conversions on invalid constructor overloads #78514
    Area-Compilers, Need More Info, Community, untriaged
